description: This Rust source file defines the syntax tree and parameter handling for SQL page statement parameters, including the StmtParam enum, SQL function call representation, and functions for extracting and evaluating parameters asynchronously within a web server context.

classes.name: StmtParam
classes.description: Enumeration representing different types of SQL statement parameters, including literals, variables, function calls, and composite types.

classes.name: SqlPageFunctionCall
classes.description: Struct representing a call to a sqlpage function, including its name and arguments.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Implements display formatting for StmtParam and SqlPageFunctionCall, converting them to their SQL string representations.

methods.name: from_func_call
methods.description: Creates a SqlPageFunctionCall from a function name and arguments parsed from SQL.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a SqlPageFunctionCall by extracting parameters from the request and executing the function.

methods.name: extract_req_param
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts the value of a parameter from the request context, handling different parameter types and nested JSON structures.
